title: CMake: Sinsp: Silence a hundred LNK4099 warnings on MSVC
description:
The collection of libraries that makes up libsinsp doesn't include
all the PDBs, which results in MSVC complaining with LNK4099.

Create an IMPORTED INTERFACE target for sinsp (it's a bunch of
libraries; IMPORTED_LOCATION requires a single library, so this
is an INTERFACE).

This lets us specify ignoring LNK4099 when importing this library.
We can also avoid having to separately specify the include directories
when using this setup, including the special ZLib requirement on
Windows.

Ping #20792

@@ -202,11 +202,12 @@ endif()
 
   # This is terrible, but libsinsp/libscap doesn't support dynamic linking on Windows (yet).
   find_path(_zlib_include_dir NO_CACHE
-    NAMES zlib/zlib.h
+    NAMES zlib.h
     HINTS "${SINSP_INCLUDEDIR}" "${SINSP_HINTS}/include"
     PATHS
     /usr/include
     /usr/local/include
+    PATH_SUFFIXES falcosecurity/zlib
   )
   if (_zlib_include_dir)
     list(APPEND _sinsp_include_dirs ${_zlib_include_dir})
@@ -227,14 +228,13 @@ endif()
 
   if(_sinsp_include_dirs AND _sinsp_link_libs)
     list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES _sinsp_include_dirs)
-    set(SINSP_INCLUDE_DIRS ${_sinsp_include_dirs} CACHE PATH "Paths to libsinsp and libscap headers")
+    set(SINSP_INCLUDE_DIRS ${_sinsp_include_dirs} CACHE PATH "Paths to libsinsp and libscap headers" FORCE)
     # The Debug libraries link to MSVCRTD.lib on Windows, and so we need to
     # track them separately there. We don't need to do that elsewhere.
     if(WIN32)
-      set(SINSP_LINK_LIBRARIES $<IF:$<CONFIG:Debug>,${_sinsp_debug_link_libs},${_sinsp_link_libs}> CACHE PATH "Paths to libsinsp, libscap, etc.")
-    else()
-      set(SINSP_LINK_LIBRARIES ${_sinsp_link_libs} CACHE PATH "Paths to libsinsp, libscap, etc.")
+      set(SINSP_DEBUG_LINK_LIBRARIES ${_sinsp_debug_link_libs} CACHE PATH "Paths to libsinsp, libscap, etc. debug libs")
     endif()
+    set(SINSP_LINK_LIBRARIES ${_sinsp_link_libs} CACHE PATH "Paths to libsinsp, libscap, etc.")
     set(SINSP_FOUND 1)
     unset(_sinsp_include_dirs)
     unset(_sinsp_link_libs)
@@ -280,6 +280,26 @@ if(SINSP_FOUND)
 #     )
 #     mark_as_advanced( SINSP_DLL_DIR SINSP_DLL )
 #   endif()
+  if (NOT TARGET sinsp::sinsp)
+    add_library(sinsp::sinsp INTERFACE IMPORTED)
+    set_target_properties(sinsp::sinsp PROPERTIES
+        INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${SINSP_INCLUDE_DIRS}"
+    )
+    if (USE_REPOSITORY)
+      target_link_libraries(sinsp::sinsp INTERFACE
+        debug "${SINSP_DEBUG_LINK_LIBRARIES}"
+        optimized "${SINSP_LINK_LIBRARIES}"
+      )
+      # We don't have the PDBs
+      target_link_options(sinsp::sinsp INTERFACE
+        "$<$<BOOL:${MSVC}>:/IGNORE:4099>"
+      )
+    else()
+      target_link_libraries(sinsp::sinsp INTERFACE
+        "${SINSP_LINK_LIBRARIES}"
+      )
+    endif()
+  endif()
 else()
   set(SINSP_INCLUDE_DIRS)
   set(SINSP_LINK_LIBRARIES)
@@ -290,7 +310,7 @@ else()
   set(SINSP_VERSION_MICRO)
 endif()
 
-mark_as_advanced(SINSP_INCLUDE_DIRS SINSP_LINK_LIBRARIES)
+mark_as_advanced(SINSP_INCLUDE_DIRS SINSP_LINK_LIBRARIES SINSP_DEBUG_LINK_LIBRARIES)
 
 # Windows plugins

@@ -345,7 +345,7 @@ if(BUILD_dumpcalls AND SINSP_FOUND)

 		extcap-base
 		wsutil
-		${SINSP_LINK_LIBRARIES}

 	set_extlog_executable_properties(dumpcalls)
 	target_link_libraries(dumpcalls ${dumpcalls_LIBS})
-	target_include_directories(dumpcalls SYSTEM PRIVATE ${SINSP_INCLUDE_DIRS})
-	if(WIN32)
-		# libsinsp/dumper.h includes libscap/scap_savefile_api.h, which includes

-	endif()
 	install(TARGETS dumpcalls RUNTIME DESTINATION ${STRATOSHARK_EXTCAP_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
 	add_dependencies(extcaps dumpcalls)
 endif()
@@ -372,7 +366,7 @@ if(BUILD_falcodump AND SINSP_FOUND)
 	set(falcodump_LIBS
 		extcap-base
 		wsutil
-		${SINSP_LINK_LIBRARIES}
+		sinsp::sinsp
 		${CMAKE_DL_LIBS}
 		${GCRYPT_LIBRARIES}
 	)
@@ -385,12 +379,6 @@ if(BUILD_falcodump AND SINSP_FOUND)
 	add_executable(falcodump ${falcodump_FILES})
 	set_extlog_executable_properties(falcodump)
 	target_link_libraries(falcodump ${falcodump_LIBS})
-	target_include_directories(falcodump SYSTEM PRIVATE ${SINSP_INCLUDE_DIRS})
-	if(WIN32)
-		# libsinsp/dumper.h includes libscap/scap_savefile_api.h, which includes
-		# libscap/scap_zlib.h.
-		target_include_directories(falcodump SYSTEM PRIVATE ${ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR})
-	endif()
 	install(TARGETS falcodump RUNTIME DESTINATION ${STRATOSHARK_EXTCAP_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
 	add_dependencies(extcaps falcodump)
 endif()
